location: Blackrock Mountain, between the Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes
entrance: Through the portal of Blackrock Spire, high in Blackrock Mountain: the door next to the meeting stone, then the path up.

4724.objective: Kill Halycon, the pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worgs.

4981.objective: Find out what happened to Bijou in Blackrock Spire.
4981.note: Bijou sits in the dungeon and gives Bijou's Belongings next.

4903.objective: Kill Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone and Overlord Wyrmthalak, and bring back the Important Blackrock Documents.
4903.note: Cannot be shared. The start of the Horde chain towards Onyxia's Lair; next comes Eitrigg's Wisdom in Orgrimmar.

4701.objective: Kill Halycon, the source of the worg threat.

5089.objective: Bring General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell.
5089.note: Starts from the item that Overlord Wyrmthalak drops. Leads to General Drakkisath's Demise in Upper Blackrock Spire.

5001.objective: Find Bijou's Belongings in the dungeon and bring them back to her.

4862.objective: Collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs in the tunnels of Mother Smolderweb.

4729.objective: Catch a Bloodaxe Worg Pup with Kibler's cage and bring back the Caged Worg Pup.
4729.note: Cannot be shared. The pups run in Halycon's lair.

4866.objective: Let Mother Smolderweb poison you with Mother's Milk, then go back to Ragged John while still poisoned.

4742.objective: Bring Vaelan the Gemstones of Smolderthorn, Spirestone and Bloodaxe and the Unadorned Seal of Ascension.
4742.note: War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk and Overlord Wyrmthalak drop the gemstones; the seal drops from monsters in the dungeon. The finished seal opens Upper Blackrock Spire.

4867.objective: Read Warosh's Scroll and bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
4867.note: Cannot be shared. Warosh walks near the beginning of the dungeon. The mojo drops from Urok Doomhowl.

4788.objective: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot.
4788.note: The end of a chain of five quests that starts in Tanaris and runs through Zul'Farrak.
